اعتزموا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَمُوا (iʕtazamū) /iʕ.ta.za.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اُعْتُزِمُوا (uʕtuzimū) /uʕ.tu.zi.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اِعْتَزِمُوا (iʕtazimū) /iʕ.ta.zi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
